quests.instruction: Write the word 'apple'. It has two p's with tails and a tall l.
quests.question: apple
quests.hint: a is small. Both p's drop below the baseline, and l reaches the top line. End with a closed e.
quests.explanation: Five letters, two tails and a tall letter. Keep the two p's the same, and make sure the l is straight.
quests.funFact: Apples float on water because about a quarter of an apple is air.

quests.instruction: Look at the word 'bread', cover it, and write it from memory.
quests.question: bread
quests.hint: Picture the tall b at the start and the tall d at the end. The letters r, e and a go in between, all small.
quests.explanation: Writing from memory shows if your hand knows the shapes. Tall letters at both ends hold the word together.
quests.funFact: Bread is one of the oldest prepared foods in the world.

quests.instruction: Copy the word 'chair' onto your line. Watch the tall h and the dot on i.
quests.question: chair
quests.hint: c is small, h is tall, a is small, i has a dot, r is small. Write the dot after the whole word.
quests.explanation: A tall letter in the middle with a dot after it. Leave dots until the end so your hand keeps its rhythm.
quests.funFact: The ancient Egyptians used chairs more than four thousand years ago.

quests.instruction: Now try 'tiger'. It has a tail at the g.
quests.question: tiger
quests.hint: t is a bit tall, i has a dot, g has a tail below the line, e and r are small.
quests.explanation: A word with a dot, a cross and a tail. Writing them in the right order makes it neat.
quests.funFact: Every tiger has its own pattern of stripes, just as people have their own fingerprints.

quests.instruction: Next word: 'horse'. h is the only tall letter.
quests.question: horse
quests.hint: h reaches the top line. o, r, s and e are all small and sit evenly on the baseline.
quests.explanation: One tall letter and four small. Keep the small letters even to make the word look calm.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep while standing up.

quests.instruction: Write 'sheep' on the line. It has two e's side by side, and a tail at the end.
quests.question: sheep
quests.hint: s is small, h is tall, the two e's are identical, p has a tail. Close both e's.
quests.explanation: Double letters should be the same size. A tail at the end makes the word finish with a flourish.
quests.funFact: A farmer needs to cut a sheep's wool regularly, because the wool does not stop growing.

quests.instruction: Your next word is 'water'. Keep the w pointed and the t a bit tall.
quests.question: water
quests.hint: w is two valleys, a is round, t is medium, e is small, r is a half arch.
quests.explanation: Pointed letters and round letters in one word. Slow down at the points of w.
quests.funFact: About seventy percent of the Earth's surface is covered with water.

quests.instruction: Let's write 'plant'. It starts with a tail and has a tall l.
quests.question: plant
quests.hint: p's tail drops below the line, l is tall, a and n are small, t is medium.
quests.explanation: A tail first, a tall letter second. Remember to keep p and l the same distance apart as the other letters.
quests.funFact: Plants make their own food from sunlight, using a process called photosynthesis.

quests.instruction: Write the word 'cloud'. It has two tall letters, l and d.
quests.question: cloud
quests.hint: c is small, l is tall, o and u are small, d is tall. Make l and d the same height.
quests.explanation: The tall letters l and d sit at different places in the word, but their tops should line up.
quests.funFact: Clouds are made of tiny drops of water or tiny ice crystals.

quests.instruction: Copy the word 'green' onto your line. It has a tail at the start and two e's.
quests.question: green
quests.hint: g's tail drops below the baseline. r, e, e and n are small. Close both e's.
quests.explanation: A descender at the start and small letters after. Keep the e's the same size.
quests.funFact: Leaves look green because they contain a substance called chlorophyll.

quests.instruction: Now try 'white'. Take care with the tall h and the t.
quests.question: white
quests.hint: w is pointed, h is tall, i has a dot, t has a cross, e is small. Add the dot and cross at the end.
quests.explanation: Dots and crosses come last, after the main letters. This helps your word flow.
quests.funFact: White light contains all the colors of the rainbow.

quests.instruction: Next word: 'black'. It has three tall letters: b, l and k.
quests.question: black
quests.hint: b, l and k all reach the top line. a and c are small and round. Keep the tall ones straight.
quests.explanation: Three tall letters with two small ones between. The tall ones should be parallel.
quests.funFact: In ancient China and Egypt, black ink was made from soot.

quests.instruction: Write 'mouse' on the line. Its letters are all small.
quests.question: mouse
quests.hint: m has two arches, o is a circle, u is a cup, s is a curve, e is small. All of them are the same height.
quests.explanation: Five small letters, all the same height. If one looks bigger, make the next one match.
quests.funFact: The computer mouse got its name because its cord looked like a tail.

quests.instruction: Your next word is 'clock'. l and k are tall; the two c's are small.
quests.question: clock
quests.hint: c, l, o, c, k: small, tall, small, small, tall. Make the two c's identical.
quests.explanation: Repeated letters should be the same. Check your c's against each other.
quests.funFact: Mechanical clocks appeared in European town towers more than six hundred years ago.

quests.instruction: Let's write 'smile'. It has a dot, a tall l and a closed e.
quests.question: smile
quests.hint: s and m are small, i has a dot, l is tall, e is small. Close the e.
quests.explanation: Small, small, dot, tall, small. Say that rhythm as you write.
quests.funFact: A smile is understood in cultures all around the world.

quests.instruction: Write the word 'school', a six-letter word with a tall h and a tall l.
quests.question: school
quests.hint: s and c are small, h is tall, the two o's are small circles, l is tall. Keep the o's identical.
quests.explanation: Six letters need planning. Think of the word as three parts: sc, ho, ol.
quests.funFact: The word 'school' comes from a Greek word that meant 'leisure'.

quests.instruction: Copy the word 'pencil' onto your line. It has a tail at the start and a tall l at the end.
quests.question: pencil
quests.hint: p's tail drops below the line. e, n and c are small. i has a dot and l is tall.
quests.explanation: A tail at the start and a tall letter at the end make a good test of space above and below the line.
quests.funFact: By the 1600s, pencil makers in Nuremberg, Germany, were already making wooden pencils.

quests.instruction: Now try 'garden'. g has a tail and d is tall.
quests.question: garden
quests.hint: g's tail drops below. a, r, e and n are small. d reaches the top line.
quests.explanation: A tail at the start and a tall letter near the end. Don't let the tail of g touch the line below.
quests.funFact: Earthworms help gardens by loosening the soil.

quests.instruction: Next word: 'family'. It has f, l and y, three letters that go up or down.
quests.question: family
quests.hint: f and l are tall, y has a tail, and a, m and i are small. Keep the m's arches even.
quests.explanation: Six letters with three heights. Plan the tall, small and tail parts before you start.
quests.funFact: English, Hindi and Spanish all belong to one big family of languages, called Indo-European.

quests.instruction: Write 'mother' on the line. The m, o, e and r are small, the t and h are tall.
quests.question: mother
quests.hint: Two arches for m, a round o, then t and h, then e and r. Check the tall t and h are about the same height.
quests.explanation: t is slightly shorter than h. The two should be neighbors and look like a pair.
quests.funFact: In many languages, including Hindi, Spanish and Chinese, the word for mother begins with an m sound.

quests.instruction: Your next word is 'father'. It has f, t and h, three tall letters.
quests.question: father
quests.hint: f is tall, a is small, t is medium, h is tall, e and r are small. Keep your rhythm even.
quests.explanation: Tall, small, medium, tall, small, small. The tall letters give the word its skyline.
quests.funFact: The Latin word for father is 'pater', which gives us words like 'paternal'.

quests.instruction: Let's write 'friend'. It has f, d and a tall letter, and i has a dot.
quests.question: friend
quests.hint: f is tall, r, i, e, n are small, d is tall. The dot on i is the last thing you write.
quests.explanation: Tall letters at both ends and small letters in the middle. Check that f and d are the same height.
quests.funFact: The United Nations celebrates International Day of Friendship on 30 July.

quests.instruction: Write the word 'sister', with a dot on i and a cross on t.
quests.question: sister
quests.hint: s, i, s, t, e, r: add the dot and the cross after you finish the letters. Keep both s's the same.
quests.explanation: Two s's, a dot and a cross: lots of small details. Keep them tidy and in the right spot.
quests.funFact: The word 'sister' is very old, and a word like it appears in many European languages.

quests.instruction: Copy the word 'brother' onto your line. It has b, t and h, three tall letters.
quests.question: brother
quests.hint: b is tall, r and o are small, t is medium, h is tall, e and r are small.
quests.explanation: Seven letters is a real challenge. Take a breath, and keep your letters evenly spaced.
quests.funFact: 'Brother' and 'fraternal' come from the same ancient root, the Latin word 'frater'.

quests.instruction: Now try 'yellow'. It has a tail at the start and two tall l's.
quests.question: yellow
quests.hint: y's tail drops below the line. e is small, the two l's are tall and parallel, o and w are small.
quests.explanation: A descender at the start and double tall letters in the middle. Keep both l's the same height.
quests.funFact: Yellow is used on many warning signs because it is easy to see.

quests.instruction: Next word: 'orange'. The g has a tail at the end.
quests.question: orange
quests.hint: o, r, a, n and e are small. g's tail drops below the baseline at the end of the word.
quests.explanation: A word full of small letters with just one tail at the end. Plan space under the line for the g.
quests.funFact: The color orange was named after the fruit, not the other way around.

quests.instruction: Write 'purple' on the line. It has two p's and a tall l.
quests.question: purple
quests.hint: Both p's have tails. u and r are small, l is tall, e is small. Keep both tails the same length.
quests.explanation: Two tails, one tall letter. Check that the tails don't bump into each other.
quests.funFact: Purple dye was once so costly that it was made from tiny sea snails and used mostly by kings.

quests.instruction: Your next word is 'banana'. After the b, the 'na' sound repeats twice, which gives the word a nice rhythm.
quests.question: banana
quests.hint: b is tall, and every other letter is small. Say 'ba-na-na' as you write and keep the n's even.
quests.explanation: A repeating pattern is easier to keep neat. Make your second 'na' look like your first.
quests.funFact: Botanists classify the banana as a berry.

quests.instruction: Let's write 'carrot'. It has a double r and a t at the end.
quests.question: carrot
quests.hint: c, a, r, r and o are small. Make the second r a copy of the first. The t comes last, with its cross at the middle line.
quests.explanation: Double letters should be the same. Your second r should look like a copy of the first.
quests.funFact: Carrots can be purple, yellow or white as well as orange.

quests.instruction: Write the word 'tomato'. It has two t's and two o's.
quests.question: tomato
quests.hint: t, o, m, a, t, o. Both t's get a cross at the middle line, and both o's are closed circles.
quests.explanation: Repeated letters in a word are a chance to check your consistency. Compare your two t's and two o's.
quests.funFact: Tomatoes first came from South America.
